title: Transpose of graph comparison
statement: For the graph comparison map, its transpose under the etale lower-shriek restriction adjunction equals the graph extension unit.

source.place: Tags 03S3 (definition-extension-zero), 03S5 (proposition-describe-jshriek), 03S6 (lemma-shriek-base-change), 0F4L (lemma-shriek-into-star-separated-etale); more-etale.tex Tags 0F50, 0F51 and 0F7B-0F7F; graph-adjunction normalization on unbounded complexes supplied by the agent

proof.text: Express the graph comparison as the transpose of the graph projection through the etale shriek base change isomorphism. The unit law for leftAdjointUniq and the adjunction conjugate identify this transpose with the direct-image exchange followed by the graph transfer.

Compare the transfer with direct image on the clopen graph section. The inverse-image composition and identity unit equations show that restriction along the test-object graph is the identity. The localization restriction base change isomorphism transports the formula to the original test object.

Pull back the graph complement to the graph section. The pullback equations force every point into the graph, contradicting membership in its complement, so this pullback is empty. Extension by zero therefore has zero sections there, and the transfer restricts to zero on the complement.
Use graph_hom_ext to identify the two section maps from their graph and complement restrictions. The section formula defining lowerStarUnit is exactly this graph extension by zero.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportGraphSheafComparison_normalization_transpose
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {U X : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X)
    [Etale f] [IsSeparated f] (c : Compactification f)
    (M : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) :
    (etaleLowerShriekRestrictionAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).homEquiv M
        ((f)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A].obj M)
      ((etaleCompactificationGraphMap A f c).app M ≫
        (compactificationSheafToDirectImage A c).app M) =
      (lowerStarUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).app M
